gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Noto Sans Deseret is a friendly sans with a high, wide-looking lowercase and open apertures that keep it legible. Redux sits above it with generous letter spacing and big curved entrances, and a slightly larger body size would suit that.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari reads modern and compact, with a g that leaves its lower curve open and capitals that melt into the lowercase. Redux handles the showy work with wide spacing and swooping curve entrances, while the sans body simply keeps the text moving.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Wide, generous and a bit playful: Redux spaces its enlarged lowercase out while the plain sans below opens up its a and e. Mild stress keeps every heading stroke solid.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Redux spreads its enlarged lowercase wide, with big visible entrances into every curve and a gentle weight shift that never snags the eye. Noto Sans Elbasan sits beside it as a plain sans with large forms and open terminals, so the two feel relaxed and roomy together.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Redux gives its rounded strokes a soft gradient of weight, with wide spacing and a big visible entrance into each curve. Noto Sans Elymaic stays open and plain beside it.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Redux stretches its letters wide and lets hairlines stay present without turning razor thin, with generous entrances into every curve. Noto Sans Ethiopic follows with a tall, sturdy lowercase and hanging c terminals, so a long passage would read smoothly.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian keeps its aperture curves open across the alphabet, with short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Redux is the one for display flair, with spaced-out letters and a subtle weight gradient along each curve, while the plain sans body does the quiet reading.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Noto Sans Glagolitic has open round letters that stay clear at small sizes, and its lowercase stands tall and sturdy. Redux joins it with wide spacing and arches that thin slowly into lighter joins, so the sans-serif body steadies the display heading.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Redux spaces its enlarged lowercase widely, with weight changes that are present but never dramatic. Noto Sans Gothic adds counters as big as drilled glass beads, and its round forms read like open parentheses.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha is tall and compact, never closing up a bowl. Redux does the showing off with wide spacing, big curve entrances and sturdy thin lines against slightly heavier thick ones, while the sans body simply keeps reading easy.
